name: Funny Honey
source:
This is a dating simulation game with four (plus 4 hidden) girls as possible lovers. But winning a girl's heart is not the end. The real emotional drama only starts from there.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-june-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一款恋爱模拟游戏，有4名（另有4名隐藏）女孩可成为恋人。但赢得女孩的心并不是终点，真正的情感剧才从那时开始。

[据[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-june-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]编辑]
